name: CapitalDataPackage
description: An aggregate data package containing the credit risk, market risk, and operational risk RWA calculation outputs for a given quarter-end reporting date. This is the handover artefact from Risk Management (CAP-004) to Compliance & Regulatory (CAP-005). It contains the calculated figures and data lineage references needed to populate the COREP XBRL return templates.

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the capital data package

fields.name: reporting_period
fields.description: The quarter this package covers, e.g., 2026-Q1
fields.validation: Required. Must match a valid quarter-end date.

fields.name: quarter_end_date
fields.description: The quarter-end date for the reporting period
fields.validation: Required. Must be a valid quarter-end date (31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December).

fields.name: credit_risk_rwa
fields.description: Total credit risk RWA under the applicable approach (SA or IRB with output floor)

fields.name: credit_risk_approach
fields.description: The approach used for credit risk RWA calculation

fields.name: output_floor_applied
fields.description: Whether the Basel 3.1 output floor was binding for this quarter

fields.name: output_floor_percentage
fields.description: The output floor percentage in effect (50% rising to 72.5%)

fields.name: market_risk_rwa
fields.description: Total market risk RWA under FRTB Standardised Approach

fields.name: operational_risk_capital
fields.description: Operational risk capital requirement under Basel Standardised Approach

fields.name: data_lineage
fields.description: References to source system extracts used in the calculation

fields.name: loan_book_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the loan book data extract

fields.name: trading_book_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the trading book data extract

fields.name: op_loss_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the operational loss data extract

fields.name: extraction_timestamp
fields.description: When the source data was extracted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the capital data package

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the package was created

relationships.description: The CapitalDataPackage is consumed by the COREPReturn entity during return consolidation

design_decisions.decision: CapitalDataPackage is owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine Service) in CAP-004, not by SVC-015 in CAP-005
design_decisions.rationale: The calculation outputs are produced by the Risk Management capability. Compliance & Regulatory consumes a copy of this data via the CapitalDataPackageAssembled domain event. Each capability owns its own representation per the architecture specification.
